What is degeneracy? Let us first appeal to the Cambridge dictionary, documenting some features of typical uses of the word within mathematics:"]}],"\n",["$","blockquote",null,{"children":["\n",["$","p",null,{"children":[["$","em",null,{"children":"Degenerate"}]," (of an equation, curve, line, etc.) unusual or complicated in some way compared to other equations, curves, lines, etc.  of a similar type, especially because a variable or parameter is zero."]}],"\n"]}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":["On the other hand, we should recall that deep learning has as many roots in neuroscience as in mathematics. And as they say, \"neural networks are ",["$","em",null,{"children":"grown."}],"\" Perhaps we should also hear the biologist's definition:"]}],"\n",["$","blockquote",null,{"children":["\n",["$","p",null,{"children":[["$","em",null,{"children":"Degenerate"}]," (of an organism, chromosome, etc.) simpler than a form that previously existed because of no longer having a particular structure."]}],"\n"]}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":["Actually, ",["$","em",null,{"children":"both"}]," of these definitions are apt. Within a typical neural network architecture, certain weight vectors correspond to neural networks from simpler architectures (often due to certain weights being zero). Structurally, these neural networks are simpler in form than their neighbours. Mathematically, they complicate the relationship between the neural network's parameter space and the resulting space of functions. In turn, learning in neural networks is substantially richer than learning in classical statistical models."]}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"Singular learning theory is a framework for understanding learning that places degeneracy at the centre. The framework leverages powerful tools from algebraic geometry to understand, characterise, and resolve degeneracies, revealing their impact on learning. Unfortunately, the price of this mathematical power is that following the research literature without a deep background in pure mathematics is challenging."}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"That is where this tutorial comes in. We aim to distil the essence of singular learning theory—the notion of degeneracy and its role in learning—laying bare through simple examples and structured exercises the core intuitions driving research in the field. We believe understanding this essence requires no more than undergraduate-level mathematics. Moreover, to anyone armed with these core intuitions, understanding and contributing to research on the relationship between degeneracy and deep learning is within 13f:["$","p",null,{"children":["While the theoretical foundation of SLT is described across many research papers by Watanabe and others, the main results are collected in self-contained form in these monographs. 140:["$","h3",null,{"id":"52-recent-work-on-singular-deep-learning","children":"5.2 Recent work on singular deep learning"}]
141:["$","p",null,{"children":["Over the last few years, a community of researchers have pursued the application of SLT to advancing the science and safety of deep learning. Some of the ideas behind this research are discussed by ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-hoogland-2023","children":"Hoogland et al. 2023"}],"; ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-skalse-2023","children":"Skalse 2023"}],"; ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-pepinlehalleur-2025","children":"Pepin Lehalleur et al. 2025"}],"; ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-furman2026","children":"Furman 2026"}],". We briefly survey some key topics in this emerging literature."]}]
142:["$","p",null,{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Characterising and estimating degeneracy in practice."}],"  We have seen examples of parameter–function map degeneracy in simple neural networks. Symmetries of neural network parameter–function maps have long been studied, however often the emphasis has been on discrete or globally continuous symmetries rather than additional symmetries localised to subsets of parameter space (see ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-farrugiaroberts2022","children":"Farrugia-Roberts 2022"}],", § 2.3, for a survey). For two-layer hyperbolic tangent networks, ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-farrugiaroberts2024","children":"Farrugia-Roberts 2024"}]," characterises the regions of parameter space which display additional degeneracy, and ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-farrugiaroberts2023","children":"Farrugia-Roberts 2023"}]," characterises degenerate directions in the parameter–function map."]}]
143:["$","p",null,{"children":["As discussed, analytically calculating the (local) learning coefficient for deep neural networks is challenging. However, precise formulas have been derived for multi-layer deep linear networks (",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-aoyagi-watanabe2005","children":"Aoyagi & Watanabe 2005"}],"; ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-aoyagi2024","children":"Aoyagi 2024"}],"), two-layer hyperbolic tangent networks (",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-aoyagi2009","children":"Aoyagi 2009"}],"), and certain other architectures. These results assume data is generated from a known \"teacher\" model."]}]
144:["$","p",null,{"children":["In practice, we lack knowledge of the true data generating process, and we use more complex architectures. Much work has therefore built on the foundational methods of estimating the local learning coefficient with scalable Markov chain Monte Carlo methods (",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-lau-2025","children":"Lau et al. 2025"}],"; ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-hitchcock-hoogland2025","children":"Hitchcock & Hoogland 2025"}],"). For a practical introduction to learning coefficient estimation, see ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-furman2023","children":"Furman 2023"}],". ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-chen-murfet2025","children":"Chen & Murfet 2025"}]," characterises the sensitivity of local learning coefficient estimation to patterns in sequence models."]}]
145:["$","p",null,{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Bayesian phase transitions and stagewise development."}],"  As we have discussed, Watanabe's free energy formula suggests Bayesian deep learning should undergo Bayesian phase transitions under certain conditions. ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-carroll2021","children":"Carroll 2021"}]," studied Bayesian phase transitions in small ReLU networks, and ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-chen-2023","children":"Chen et al. 2023"}]," studied Bayesian phase transitions in a small feature autoencoder (the \"toy model of superposition\" from ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-elhage-2022","children":"Elhage et al. 2022"}],")."]}]
146:["$","p",null,{"children":["In practice, we use stochastic gradient-based optimisation, rather than Bayesian learning, to train neural networks. However, the Bayesian case serves as a model system from which we can derive empirically testable predictions. ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-chen-2023","children":"Chen et al. 2023"}]," formulate the ",["$","em",null,{"children":"Bayesian antecedent hypothesis"}],", the empirical conjecture that observed phase transitions in trained neural networks correspond to Bayesian phase transitions modelled by Watanabe's free energy formula. ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-chen-2023","children":"Chen et al. 2023"}]," study such ",["$","em",null,{"children":"dynamical phase transitions"}]," in their toy autoencoder and observe a temporal correspondence between phase changes and estimated LLC increases consistent with the free energy formula."]}]
147:["$","p",null,{"children":[["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-wang-2024","children":"Wang et al. 2024"}],"; ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-hoogland-2025","children":"Hoogland et al. 2025"}]," scale this methodology to transformers trained on natural language, finding similar ",["$","em",null,{"children":"stagewise development"}]," phenomena with changes in behaviour and internal structure accompanied by LLC changes. ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-panickssery-vaintrob2023","children":"Panickssery & Vaintrob 2023"}],"; ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-hoogland-2025","children":"Hoogland et al. 2025"}],"; ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-carroll-2025","children":"Carroll et al. 2025"}],"; ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-urdshals-urdshals2025","children":"Urdshals & Urdshals 2025"}]," also study developmental stages in transformers trained on synthetic data. ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-elliott-2026","children":"Elliott et al. 2026"}]," extends this study to a case of goal misgeneralisation in deep reinforcement learning."]}]
148:["$","p",null,{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Degeneracy, interpretability, and patterning."}],"  The LLC provides a single number representing the effective dimensionality of a model. We can derive from the same principles—asymptotic properties of the posterior that reflect degeneracies in the model—more fine-grained tools for probing the internal computational structures of neural networks and how they depend on data."]}]
149:["$","ul",null,{"children":["\n",["$","li",null,{"children":[["$","em",null,{"children":"Weight- and data-refined LLCs:"}]," ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-wang-2025differentiation","children":"Wang et al. 2025"}]," compute LLCs of individual transformer modules (e.g., different attention heads) or with respect to different subsets of a data set (e.g., natural language versus code). Observing these refined quantities over training reveals modules developing different structures specialising to different kinds of data."]}],"\n",["$","li",null,{"children":[["$","em",null,{"children":"Susceptibilities:"}]," Drawing inspiration from electromagnetic susceptibilities in physics ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-baker-2025","children":"Baker et al. 2025"}],"; ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-wang-2025embryology","children":"Wang et al. 2025"}],"; ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-gordon-2026","children":"Gordon et al. 2026"}]," develop and apply a methodology for computing loss susceptibilities so as to reveal more fine-grained information about how model internals relate to data."]}],"\n",["$","li",null,{"children":[["$","em",null,{"children":"Bayesian influence functions:"}]," Similarly, drawing inspiration from training data attribution in statistics, ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-kreer-2025","children":"Kreer et al. 2025"}],"; ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-lee-2025","children":"Lee et al. 2025"}],"; ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-adam-2025","children":"Adam et al. 2025"}]," develop a Bayesian generalisation of classical influence functions that allows the influence functions to be sensitive to higher-order degeneracy in the model."]}],"\n"]}]
14a:["$","p",null,{"children":"Weight- and data-refined LLCs are themselves LLCs with a different model or data set, and so the same scalable Markov chain Monte Carlo methods can be used to estimate them as for LLCs. Moreover, like the LLC, susceptibilities and Bayesian influence functions can be approximated as expectations over a localised posterior distribution, and so similar estimation methods can be used for these quantities too."}]
14b:["$","p",null,{"children":[["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-wang-murfet2026","children":"Wang & Murfet 2026"}]," develop a methodology, ",["$","em",null,{"children":"patterning"}],", for making targeted changes to the training distribution so as to elicit certain changes in the development of neural network internal structure or generalisation behaviour."]}]
14c:["$","p",null,{"children":["$","strong",null,{"children":"Foundations of singular deep learning."}]}]
14d:["$","p",null,{"children":"There has been some work on developing the foundational theory of SLT and deep learning."}]
14e:["$","p",null,{"children":["For example, ",["$","a",null,{"href":"#bib-elliott-2026","children":"Elliott et al. 2026"}]," generalise Watanabe's free energy formula from Bayesian inference to a generalised non-stationary energy-based inference setting, so as to account for stagewise development in deep reinforcement learning."]}]
14f:["$","p",null,{"children":"Beyond the setting of Bayesian inference, the general role degeneracy plays in the learning dynamics of stochastic gradient-based optimisation remains to be characterised."}]
150:["$","p",null,{"children":"Finally, there has been some attempt to theoretically investigate the links between degeneracy in deep learning and computational structure in models."}]
